Dmitri Sorensen
dmitri.sorensen566@example.com | Detroit, MI
Dmitri Sorensen has 8 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Hollowbrook Networks (2022-2026),
where they designed internal Node.js standards used by 7+ downstream services.
Before that, Backend Engineer at Silverline Digital (2020-2022). Before that,
Software Engineer I at Quartzline Labs (2018-2020). Education: B.S. Information
Systems, Purdue University, 2017. Core skills: Elasticsearch, Distributed
systems, AWS, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Kafka, Redis.
